steps.en: Get the standalone binary (release page, package manager or Docker image)
steps.zh: 拿到独立二进制（release 页、包管理器或 Docker 镜像）

steps.en: Pipe JSON into it from a file, curl or another CLI
steps.zh: 把文件、curl 或别的命令行工具输出的 JSON 管道给它

steps.en: Parses each JSON value and pretty-prints it, so you can see the shape
steps.zh: 解析每个 JSON 值并格式化打印，让你看清结构

steps.en: Write a filter: walk the path, iterate, select, reshape
steps.zh: 写一个过滤器：沿路径取值、展开、筛选、重组

steps.en: Runs the filter on every input value and emits a stream of results
steps.zh: 对每个输入值跑一遍过滤器，输出一串结果

steps.en: Prints JSON — or bare strings with -r for the next shell command
steps.zh: 打印 JSON——加 -r 则输出纯字符串，交给下一个 shell 命令

value.en: Any question about any JSON is one shell line, not a throwaway script per question
value.zh: 对任意 JSON 的任何问题，都是一行 shell，而不是每个问题写一个用完就扔的脚本

sources: https://github.com/jqlang/jq README (fetched 2026-10-08): prebuilt standalone executables; Docker image ghcr.io/jqlang/jq:latest; 'zero runtime dependencies'

https://jqlang.org/manual/ (fetched 2026-10-08): a filter takes an input and produces an output; filters run on a stream of JSON data; --raw-output / -r; --arg; --slurp / -s; --stream for very large inputs
